Jordan CSM: PulseWell goes live in 4h. Finance flagged erratic demo tail and renewals team wants a short customer-facing Day0 runbook + a tiny feedback capture we can use during the demo. Can we make something super short (copy/paste) that includes a prefill plan, batching defaults, streaming fallback, and a one-click feedback form link?

Pri CS-Ops: I'll draft a compact one-pager. Keep it non-technical so the customer can follow, but include an ops 'if-then' line for their engs.

Mina SRE: Model/context: 7B-q4, streaming enabled on chat. Observed p95=390ms, p99=1.5s in demo spikes. Target for them: p95 <350ms p99 <1.0s.

Ibrahim Eng: Customer-facing Day0 (copy/paste toggles):

```
1) Warm Pools: Settings > Performance -> Warm Pools = ON
2) Prefill: prefill.intents = [welcome,search,faq,summary]; cadence = 30m
3) Warm slots: start = 2 (increase +1 per 500 DAU)
4) Client batching: client_window_ms = 25 (jitter ±10ms); max_batch = 36
   - If UI is very bursty: set client_window_ms = 10; max_batch = 20
5) Streaming guardrail: stream_threshold_ms = 700 -> fallback_model = "7B-lite-q4"
6) Observation: export p95/p99 and token_cost to CSV at T-24h and T+48h for renewal report
7) Feedback form: share quick feedback after demo: https://forms.redwood.ai/pulsewell-feedback
```

Pri CS-Ops: Short internal CS checklist (post-deploy): run 6 synthetic prefills, confirm warm slots active, collect T+48h CSV, capture 3 customer feedback responses, then update renewal health card.

Sasha PM: For renewal reporting add a simple scorecard: baseline vs T+48h for p95, p99, tokens. If p99 improves ≥30% mark as "improving". Otherwise plan an ops deep-dive.

Mina SRE: Ops commands if they consent to Redwood assist: `rbnctl warmup --tenant pulsewell --slots 3 --intents top_intents.json --at 03:30` and quick probe `rbnctl probe --tenant pulsewell --route /generate --n 5`. Also enable auto-scale-down: scale_to_zero_after = 72h idle.

Ibrahim Eng: Small engineering note for their devs: enable a tiny prefix cache (session_prefix_ttl = 10m) and increase to 1h for billing/account templates to cut repeated prompt tokens.

Jordan CSM: Love it. Pri can you package the one-pager and the feedback form link into a single PDF I can drop in the kickoff? Also include a tiny consent snippet: "I authorize Redwood to perform a 72-hour warm-pool assist."

onboard-bot: scheduled warmup job for tenant pulsewell at 2026-04-10T03:30:00Z (3 slots) created by Pri CS-Ops

Pri CS-Ops: PDF will include a one-line consent checkbox, the CSV template (timestamp,route,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens,requests,error_rate,notes) and the feedback form link. I'll post it here when ready.

Sasha PM: I'll add PulseWell to the renewal-watchboard as "monitor-high" and require a follow-up 7 days after go-live with the CSV + feedback summary.

Jordan CSM: Thanks team . This exactly covers the customer-facing and internal pieces I need for the call. I'll ask for consent and start the warm-pool assist if approved. :rocket:
